en: Colorized vintage view over a river toward a European hillside city. In the foreground are riverside promenades, trees, and a bridge. Across the river stand historic buildings with red roofs and a tall white church tower with a green dome. Above the town rises a hill with fortification walls and several buildings on top, including a prominent clock tower. The caption at the top, in red German text, reads: "Graz. Schlossberg und Franziskanerkirche."
